title: Cache Insights Per-Test Result
description: Schema for per-test result records written to results/. Mirrors DESIGN.prd.md §6.1.

test_type.description: Test scenario from §4.1 (cache mechanics) or §4.2 (primitive validation).

model.description: Vendor-qualified model identifier as reported by the CLI / API.

nonce.description: Per-test nonce (≥4096 tokens per §3) recorded verbatim for contamination tracing.

verdict.description: Test outcome. Common values: cache_hit_confirmed, cache_miss, byte_identity_preserved, byte_identity_broken, contaminated, error, skipped. Open enum — additional verdict strings allowed for new test types.

hit_ratio.description: Observed cache hit ratio for the test, when applicable.

actual_wait_seconds.description: For TTL tests: actual sleep duration between requests.

contaminated.description: True if the first 'cold' request reported nonzero cached tokens (§4.1 invariant). Per DESIGN §8, contaminated results are excluded from aggregates.

error.description: Error description if the test could not produce valid measurements (per DESIGN §8). Presence does not preclude partial 'requests' data.

cli_version.description: Vendor CLI version under test (per DESIGN §5.3 prerequisite pinning).

cli_version_source.description: Verbatim stdout of the vendor's --version command, for warmup-cache traceability.

cached_at.description: When this result was written to the warmup cache (only present on warmup-cache loads).

metrics.description: Per-turn calibration outputs (prefix_warmup test). Strict shape so downstream consumers can rely on key presence.

overhead_per_turn.description: Per-turn delta input_tokens - cumulative_user_content_tokens (CLI overhead from system prompt + tool defs).

first_cache_engagement_turn.description: Smallest turn index where cached_tokens > 0; null if cache never engaged.

hit_ratio_per_turn.description: Per-turn cached_tokens / input_tokens ratio (0 when input_tokens == 0).

expected_user_content_per_turn.description: Per-turn cumulative count of user-content tokens sent (the local count; CLI may report higher input_tokens due to system prompt).

raw_usage.description: Verbatim usage block from the local attribution source (Claude JSONL, Gemini OTel, Codex OTel) for traceability.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Anthropic-only: tokens written into the cache on this request.
